**Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).**

Root cause is `dep-4471` flipping `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `true`. Roll that back. Config only, so a revert is enough.

Window ran `02:14:18Z` to `03:59:27Z` and never recovered. 530 failures out of 636 requests, an 83% error rate. Five endpoints hit, `/health` untouched, so checks stayed green.

Two gaps I flagged in the doc. Only node-3 of 3 was in the logs. The dates read March 14, not last night.
